assertion.statement: For the actual non-CM conjugate D210 fiber surfaces A and A_sigma, the normalizer action gives a geometric isogeny; the full geometric endomorphism algebra is B. For prescribed embeddings of the same quadratic field F, an isogeny intertwining those embeddings exists over the same fiber field L.
assertion.objects: Actual conjugate fiber surfaces of the entire principal-level-three curve, their rank-one left-B rational Hodge objects, geometric Hom lattices, and the prescribed two embeddings of F.
assertion.hypotheses: The full PEL/normalizer comparison and same-L Hom descent are supplied. A is non-CM. The rational Hodge equivalence and Skolem-Noether for the simple subalgebra embeddings are retained at their actual scopes.
assertion.quantifiers: Each conjugate surface in the same normalizer orbit and each pair of the prescribed embeddings of F.
assertion.parameter_range: Dimension-two quaternionic surfaces with B the rational division algebra of discriminant210.
assertion.uniformity: One and the same L defines all resulting geometric homomorphisms; no new field-degree cost.
assertion.constants: No quantitative isogeny-degree estimate or coherent cocycle bound is asserted.
assertion.normalizations: A finite-adelic move changes only a commensurable integral lattice in the same rational Hodge object. Use torsion density and invariant graph descent to obtain the geometric map, then clear rational Hom denominators after inner conjugation.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The F-linear isogenies need not be chosen coherently. This does not construct the later B-linear scalar-normalizer maps, sign splitting, compatible family, or bounded descent to a rational GL2-type variety.
assertion.limit_order: Construct the complex isogeny by finite torsion quotient; descend its graph geometrically; identify End^0=B in the non-CM case; apply Skolem-Noether, clear denominators and use the already fixed Hom field L.
